prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: The history shows the macro-balance hinge (c008) cut repair flips but raised crit_cross and lost score, while a pure cut-only backbone keeps crit_cross low; so keep the baseline cut/bin backbone and replace the hard 0.05 dead-band macro hinge with a soft, always-on but low-weight quadratic macro-balance term (no dead-band, no clamp) that gently steers macro count/area toward 50% without the aggressive flips that mangled structure.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=-0.396 robust(mean-std)=-0.237 min_case=-0.263 seed_std=0.337 tns_mean=-0.109 all_valid=True
  C1: score=-0.129 dWNS=-7.8% dTNS=-11.3% per-seed=[+0.08 -0.62 +0.15]
  C2: score=-0.263 dWNS=-18.8% dTNS=-28.1% per-seed=[+0.04 -0.36 -0.47]
  C3: score=-0.004 dWNS=-5.2% dTNS=+10.2% per-seed=[+0.37 +0.24 -0.62]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->137, wcut 421->442, crit_cross 0.011->0.126, repair_flips 103->75, changed-vs-baseline 23.1%
  C2: cut 318->340, wcut 1007->1141, crit_cross 0.000->0.120, repair_flips 238->212, changed-vs-baseline 33.2%
  C3: cut 582->535, wcut 1955->1750, crit_cross 0.069->0.002, repair_flips 353->284, changed-vs-baseline 32.1%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: All runs valid. Hypothesis partly held: repair flips fell (103→75, 238→212, 353→284) and C3 crit_cross dropped (0.069→0.002), but crit_cross rose sharply on C1/C2 (0.011→0.126, 0.000→0.120) and cut/wcut worsened on C2, driving score losses (C2 −0.263). Soft term still perturbs structure enough to create critical-pair crossings. Seed spread is unacceptable (std 0.337; C3 per-seed +0.37 to −0.62). Next: sweep the quadratic weight downward and add a crit_cross-aware penalty, validating per-seed stability before accepting.
